# logfire_organization_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of an organization with their roles. By default that is the organization of the provider's credential. On a self-hosted instance, an instance-admin credential lists another organization with the `organization` argument or the provider `organization`. The provider API key requires the `organization:read_member` scope. It needs a Logfire backend from 2026-06-11 (v2026-06-11.01) or newer, and from 2026-06-25 (v2026-06-25.01) to list another organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "logfire_organization_members" "all" {}

output "admin_emails" {
  value = [for m in data.logfire_organization_members.all.members : m.email if m.role == "admin"]
}

# On a self-hosted instance, an instance-admin key lists another organization.
data "logfire_organization_members" "team_a" {
  organization = "team-a"
}

# The user ID of a member, found by email address, for logfire_organization_member.
output "alice_user_id" {
  value = one([for m in data.logfire_organization_members.team_a.members : m.id if lower(m.email) == "alice@example.com"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Organization name. Defaults to the provider `organization`, else the organization of the provider credential, which the data source shows when the key can read it (`organization:read`). Setting it acts in that organization through the instance-admin token exchange (self-hosted only).

### Read-Only

- `members` (Attributes List) The members, ordered by email address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The member's email address.
- `id` (String) The user ID.
- `name` (String) The member's name.
- `role` (String) The name of the member's role. It is a custom role's name when the role is not built in.
